text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Friday. Reuters has not verified them nor does it vouch for their accuracy.
- Macedonia takes over $280 million of former Yugoslavia's foreign debt to the London Club of creditors.

- A poll of 2,800 citizens conducted by DATA-press pool puts leaders of SDAM Branko Crvenkovski (49.7 percent) and the Democratic Party Petar Gosev (40.67 percent) as the most popular party leaders of Maacedonia. Leaders of IMRO-DPMNY and of PDPA (ethnic Albanian) at the bottom of the list.
- The Macedonian army to buy weapons worth $200 million."We are not obliged to buy weapons from the western market," Defence ministry spokesman Petar Atasov said.

- Macedonian-Yugoslav border commission met in Skopje on Thursday. The two sides agreeed to work on the basis of international principles for establishing borders and to hold their next meeting in Belgrade
- Macedonian President Kiro Gligorov congratulates U.N. Secretary General on the 51st anniversary of the international organisation.
